data.summary:
An **ASURYANI** army gets a fresh pool of Battle Focus tokens as each battle round starts: 2 at Incursion, 4 at Strike Force, 6 at Onslaught. Discard what remains when the round ends.

When an Agile Manoeuvre's trigger occurs, you may spend 1 token to have an eligible unit perform it. A unit is eligible if it has Battle Focus and has made no Agile Manoeuvre yet this phase. Unless the manoeuvre says otherwise, it can be triggered once per phase.

The Agile Manoeuvres:

- **Swift as the Wind**: as an eligible unit of yours is chosen for a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), an Advance or a Fall Back, its models gain +2″ Move for that phase. Other eligible units may also use it in the same phase.
- **Flitting Shadows**: as an eligible unit of yours is chosen for a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), an Advance or a Fall Back, is placed on the battlefield or declares a charge, enemy units can't shoot it with the **[Fire Overwatch](vsdata:core-rule/fire-overwatch)** Stratagem for the rest of that turn.
- **Star Engines**: as an eligible **VEHICLE** unit of yours is chosen to Advance, its ranged weapons gain **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** for the rest of that turn.
- **Sudden Strike**: as an eligible unit of yours is chosen to fight, for the rest of that phase each Pile-in or Consolidation by one of its models may cover 6″ rather than 3″.
- **Opportunity Seized**: after an enemy unit finishes a Fall Back, one eligible non-**TITANIC** unit of yours that began the phase in Engagement Range of it may make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), capped at D6+1″.
- **Fade Back**: in the opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit shoots, one eligible non-**TITANIC** unit of yours hit by at least one of its attacks may make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), capped at D6+1″.

Swift as the Wind.trigger: eligible friendly unit chosen to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move

Flitting Shadows.trigger: eligible friendly unit chosen to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge
Flitting Shadows.effect: enemy units cannot shoot with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem at it

Star Engines.trigger: eligible friendly VEHICLE unit selected to make an Advance move
Star Engines.weapons: ranged weapons equipped by the unit

Sudden Strike.trigger: eligible friendly unit selected to fight

Opportunity Seized.trigger: an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move
Opportunity Seized.eligibleUnit: non-TITANIC, began the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit

Fade Back.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has shot
Fade Back.eligibleUnit: non-TITANIC, hit by one or more of those attacks
